title: Counting with Attention and LayerNorm: Norm Scaling and Representation Geometry
abstract: arXiv:2610.16653v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Counting is a simple task on which transformers can nevertheless fail at long sequence lengths. We study the cost of counting in a single attention layer, up to a maximum length $L$, focusing on how softmax attention and layer normalization shape the representation from which the count is recovered. We mainly focus on regression read-out but also consider classification read-out. For regression, we show unnormalized linear attention counts exactly at parameter norms independent of $L$. For softmax attention, regression cannot count exactly with finite parameters; it recovers the count after rounding, but only when the vector parameter norms grow with $L$. We measure this cost by $B_{\min}$, the smallest bound that can be placed on every trainable vector to ensure exact counting after rounding, and derive tight rates. translated_title: 基于注意力与层归一化的计数：范数缩放与表示几何
translated_abstract: 计数是一项简单的任务，但Transformer在长序列上却可能失败。我们研究了在单个注意力层中计数（最长序列长度为 $L$）的代价，重点关注softmax注意力和层归一化如何塑造用于恢复计数的表示。我们主要关注回归读出，但也考虑分类读出。对于回归，我们证明了未归一化的线性注意力可以在与 $L$ 无关的参数范数下精确计数。对于softmax注意力，回归无法用有限参数实现精确计数；它只能在舍入后恢复计数，且仅当向量参数范数随 $L$ 增长时才行。我们用 $B_{\min}$ 来衡量这一代价，即为确保舍入后精确计数而施加在每个可训练向量上的最小界，并推导出紧致的速率。在固定模型维度下，无归一化时 $B_{\min}$ 随 $L$ 增长，在朴素后归一化下随 $L^{3/2}$ 增长……
tldr: 本文量化了单层注意力实现精确计数的参数范数代价 $B_{\min}$，证明线性注意力可在与序列长度 $L$ 无关的范数下精确计数，而softmax注意力在无归一化时需要范数随 $L$ 增长、在后归一化下随 $L^{3/2}$ 增长。
en_tdlr: This paper quantifies the parameter-norm cost of exact counting in a single attention layer, showing that linear attention counts exactly with norms independent of sequence length $L$, while softmax attention requires norms growing as $L$ (unnormalized) or $L^{3/2}$ (post-normalization).
